## What's new

- **Folders with no cover.** Some folders suit no cover, such as a collection from one producer. Right-click the folder and choose **Remove cover...**, or click **No cover** in the cover window. Its tile shows the folder's initial, and covers chosen automatically or for many folders at once leave it alone, even when you choose to replace existing covers. Choosing a cover for it yourself gives it one again.
- **Clear every scene tag.** **Settings › Storage** can take every tag off every scene, to start them again. Folders' own tags, categories, attributes, ratings and plays are kept. Because it can't be undone from the app, you type a phrase first, which is made up afresh each time and can't be pasted. Your catalogue is copied to your data folder first, so the tags can be brought back by putting that copy in place of `index.db.gz` while the app is closed.

## Changes

- **An easier-to-read User Guide.** A section now starts on a new page when it won't fit on the one before, rather than leaving a line or two of text apart from its picture. The guide also covers both new features.
